# TreeSelect

TreeSelect: a field that picks from options that nest, at any level of the tree.

**Import:** `import { TreeSelect } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/TreeSelect/TreeSelect.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/TreeSelect/TreeSelect.stories.jsx` — Overview, SingleSelect, MultiSelect, SpacingDefault, SpacingCompact, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Focused, FieldDisabled, FieldInvalid

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/TreeSelect/TreeSelect.mdx`

**Motion:** enter `spatial.fast` + `appearance.fast` · exit `appearance.fast` · change `spatial.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations · Motion.

## Usage

Use `TreeSelect` when the options genuinely nest and someone may need to see
or pick at more than one level — a curriculum with units and lessons, a
category tree. For options that nest but are chosen one level at a time in
sequence, use `Cascader` instead. For a flat list, use `Select`.

## Motion

TreeSelect reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Opens as a Popup. |
| exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades. |
| change | Expand and collapse | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` | Columns and branches expand. |

## Best practices

### Use multi select for several branches. {#use-multi-select-for-several-branches}

With `isMulti` each chosen node is named in the field; a single value holds one.

Do: Each chosen node is named in the field.
Don't: A single value cannot hold several nodes.

### Open the tree to show nesting. {#open-the-tree-to-show-nesting}

The open tree shows how nodes nest before the choice is made. Arrow keys move through visible rows only: a collapsed branch's children are in the data but not on screen, so expand a branch first to reach what is inside it.

### Show the chosen node in the field. {#show-the-chosen-node-in-the-field}

A filled field shows the choice; an empty one cannot confirm it.

Do: The field names the chosen node.
Don't: An empty field after a choice cannot confirm it.

### Mark a failed pick on the field. {#mark-a-failed-pick-on-the-field}

With `isInvalid`, the field draws the danger border and `errorMessage` replaces the caption.

Do: A failed pick draws the danger border, so the error is seen at the field.
Don't: A failed pick still draws the normal border, so nothing marks the error.

### Checking a parent is shorthand for checking every descendant. {#checking-a-parent-is-shorthand-for-checking-every-descendant}

With `isMulti`, picking a parent node cascades the check to its whole
subtree, and a branch with only some descendants checked shows an
indeterminate mark rather than fully checked or unchecked. `value` always
reflects the actual set of checked nodes, parents included once their
subtree is complete.

```jsx
<TreeSelect
    label="Topics"
    isMulti
    value={topics}
    onChange={setTopics}
    options={[
        { value: 'roosevelt-k8', label: 'Roosevelt K-8', children: [
            { value: 'roosevelt-mon', label: 'Monday 3:30 PM' },
            { value: 'roosevelt-wed', label: 'Wednesday 3:30 PM' },
        ] },
    ]}
/>
```

## Accessibility

- **Keyboard matches what's visible.** Up/Down move between the currently
  expanded rows only, never into a collapsed branch's hidden children.
- **Checked state is explicit, including partial.** A parent with some but
  not all descendants checked is marked indeterminate, not silently rounded
  up or down to a checked or unchecked state.
- **Without a visible label, name the field explicitly** with `aria-label`
  or `aria-labelledby` — `label` is optional, but an accessible name isn't.

## Parts

1. **Field.** The box that shows the picks, or the placeholder.
2. **Label.** Names the field. A required marker follows it.
3. **Tree.** Rows that expand to their children. A parent checks its descendants.
4. **Caption.** Helper text, or the error that replaces it.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The input fill with a `--border-default` input edge; the placeholder until a node is picked. |
| Hovered | The edge turns `--ds-border-focused`. |
| Pressed | No step of its own. The hovered edge holds while the pointer is down, and the press opens the tree. |
| Focused | A `--focus-ring-width` ring in `--ds-border-focused`, `--focus-ring-width` off the box. No fill changes. |
| Disabled | The whole field fades to `--ds-opacity-disabled` and leaves the tab order. |
| Invalid | The edge takes `--ds-border-danger` and the message `--ds-text-danger`. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Box | `--ds-background-input` fill, `--border-default` edge in `--ds-border-input`. |
| Height | 40: `--height-250`. Compact 32: `--item-height-md`. |
| Radius | 10: `--radius-0625`. Compact 8: `--radius-control-md`. |
| Text | `--body-default` in `--ds-text`; placeholder `--ds-text-subtlest`. |
| Label and caption | `--body-small`; label `--ds-text`, caption `--ds-text-subtle`, error `--ds-text-danger`. |
| Tree panel | `--ds-surface-overlay` with a `--ds-border` edge, `--popup-radius` and `--ds-shadow-overlay`. |
| Row | `--item-height-md` high; hovered `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-hovered`, picked `--ds-background-selected` with `--ds-text-selected`; the expand toggle `--ds-icon-subtle`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name each node by what it is: "Lincoln Middle". | A node that only reads right under its parent. |
| Keep branches shallow, two or three levels. | A tree deeper than people can hold in mind. |
| Say what to do in an error: "Pick a topic". | "Required" or "Invalid". |
| Use the same label form at every level. | Mix a category name with a full sentence. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `name` | string | — | Submitted with a form through hidden inputs, one per value. |
| `label` | node | — | The visible label above the field. Without one, pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. |
| `caption` | node | — | Help under the field. With `isInvalid`, `errorMessage` takes its place and is announced. |
| `info` | node | — | Text for the info tooltip beside the label. |
| `value` | string or number or arrayOf | — | — |
| `options` | arrayOf | `[]` | — |
| `onChange` | func | — | — |
| `isMulti` | bool | `false` | Several values, shown as checkboxes beside the toggle. |
| `placeholder` | string | `'Please select'` | Hint text shown in the field while nothing is selected. Defaults to `Please select`. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` draws 40 and `compact` draws 32. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | — |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | Shows an asterisk on the label and sets `aria-required`. |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | Draws the error border, sets `aria-invalid`, and `errorMessage` becomes the announced caption. |
| `errorMessage` | node | — | — |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |

## Variants

**`spacing`** — `default` · `compact`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
